subject: Linguistic sign-off: Finovate case study (IT/JA versions)
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@finovate.it>, Kenji Sato <kenji.sato@hachitech.jp>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Linguistic sign-off: Finovate case study (IT/JA versions)

Hi Elena & Kenji,

Thanks again for agreeing to be a customer reference — we really appreciate the collaboration. Attached are the final English case study (EN v3) and our first-pass localized drafts for Italian (IT v2) and Japanese (JA v1).

As discussed, we want to confirm the following before public release:
- Written sign-off for the Italian and Japanese language versions.
- Permission to use Finovate logo + brief quote (we've proposed a 1-line quote under the Executive quote section).
- Any legal/PR phrasing we should avoid in the EU (specific to GDPR/data retention) in the IT text.

Timeline: ideally we'd like approvals by EOD Thu, 20 May so we can schedule the publish next week. If you want separate tracks (IT now, JA after Kenji reviews), that's fine — please indicate in your reply.

Attachments (stubs):
- Finovate_case_study_EN_v3.pdf (finalized English content)
- Finovate_case_study_IT_v2.docx (Italian draft, not yet approved)
- Finovate_case_study_JA_v1.docx (Japanese draft, machine-assisted translation + human edit)

If helpful, Marissa on our team will handle any micro-edits and can upload redlines directly to the Drive link I've included. Vivek is copied for legal/brand guardrails.

Appreciate your time — happy to hop on a 20-min call if it's easier.

Best,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Solutions | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

---

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@finovate.it>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Kenji Sato <kenji.sato@hachitech.jp>
Cc: legal@finovate.it, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 09:08:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Linguistic sign-off: Finovate case study (IT/JA versions)

Thanks, Jonas — and thanks for sending the drafts. I reviewed the Italian draft and have a few small requests (see attached redline):

1) Section "Data handling" — please adjust the phrasing to say "we retain telemetry necessary for support and billing" rather than the current broader wording. Our legal team flagged the generic retention phrasing.
2) Executive quote — please remove the specific ARR figure; we prefer a qualitative line instead (we can supply one).
3) Minor language: in the results table the performance percentages are accurate, but we'd prefer those in a footnote rather than the main paragraph.

I've attached Finovate_case_study_IT_v2_redline.docx with inline comments. Legal is looped in (legal@finovate.it) to confirm the data-handling sentence — they may respond with a suggested clause.

Regarding Japanese: Kenji, can you confirm whether the JA draft is OK for HachiTech to be quoted in this form, or if you prefer a different localization of the product name and one-line quote? If you want, we can hold JA until we get your go-ahead.

If those changes look acceptable to you, Jonas/Marissa, please update the IT file and send back a clean version for final sign-off (we need an explicit line like "Finovate S.p.A. approves publication of this case study in Italian on May 20, 2026").

Best regards,
Elena Rossi
Head of Partnerships | Finovate S.p.A.
elena.rossi@finovate.it

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Kenji Sato <kenji.sato@hachitech.jp>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 14:37:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Linguistic sign-off: Finovate case study (IT/JA versions)

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear redlines and for looping legal in.

We've accepted the three items you flagged and made the following changes:
- Reworded the Data handling paragraph to "we retain telemetry necessary for support and billing; specific logs are deleted according to our retention policy" (see IT v2 clean).
- Removed the ARR figure and replaced the executive quote with a neutral line you can tweak — I've left the placeholder in the document for you to confirm.
- Moved the performance percentages to a footnote as requested.

I've uploaded the updated Italian clean file here: https://drive.google.com/finovate-case-study-draft (Finovate_case_study_IT_v2_clean.docx). For QA, I also attached a PDF preview of the Italian layout (attachment stub: Finovate_case_study_IT_v2_preview.pdf).

For the Japanese version, Kenji — we left the JA draft untouched pending your confirmation on product naming and the quote. If you prefer, we can route the JA copy to a native reviewer in Tokyo and send a quick suggested alternative.

One small ask from our side for legal/comms: could you please respond with an explicit approval sentence we can paste into our release checklist, e.g.:

"Finovate S.p.A. approves publication of the Italian-language case study as provided on May 20, 2026, and grants permission to use the Finovate logo per the attached brand guidelines."

If we get that by EOD Thursday we'll proceed with publish scheduling. Also, Jonas — Vivek asked me to confirm that we won't include any customer email addresses or internal screenshots; that's already removed.

Thanks again — happy to jump on a 15-min call if helpful.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Content & Comms | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

You have our permission to proceed with the EN and IT publish. Please send the final live URL once published.

Best regards,
